# ATLAS

> ATLAS is an AI-powered personal learning OS: you describe one goal and it
> builds a step-by-step roadmap, then keeps lessons, notes, AI quizzes, an
> offline focus timer and progress tracking in a single app.

ATLAS helps self-directed learners plan, study and prove progress without
juggling six tools. The marketing pages below are public; the app itself
requires a free account.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://atlas.example.com/): Product overview, features, problem it
  solves and the seven-level learning journey.
- [Sign in / Create account](https://atlas.example.com/login): Entry point to
  the ATLAS app — free while in beta.

## Capabilities

- AI learning roadmap: personalised phase-by-phase plans for any skill
  (Python, Calculus, Cybersecurity, and more).
- AI quizzes: MCQs, coding challenges and debugging tests generated from your
  own course content, with pass-to-unlock levels.
- Self-organising notes linked to exact topics and courses.
- Offline focus timer with session logging and streaks.
- Squads and friends for accountability and shared streaks.
- AI assistant that answers from your own course context.
